summary: BiomX Inc. filed an amendment to its Form 8-K to supply detail on fractional-share treatment for a one-for-ten reverse stock split. The board fixed the ratio on August 28, 2026, after shareholder approval at an August 25, 2026 special meeting, effective 12:01 a.m. ET September 9, 2026. Outstanding shares fall from roughly 27.3 million to 2.7 million, authorized shares drop from 750 million to 150 million, and no fractional shares issue. This is a capital-structure action, not a special situation.
